findings.title: POST /books and PUT /books do not validate string types for book fields
findings.detail: The task requires 400 for 'a field of the wrong type', but the code accepts non-string types for title, author, isbn, and synopsis without erroring.

findings.title: GET /books/{id}, PUT /books/{id}, and DELETE /books/{id} return 404 instead of 400 for non-integer path IDs
findings.detail: The task requires 400 for 'an id in the path that is not an integer', but these endpoints return 404 (or crash) when the path ID is not an integer.

findings.title: PUT /books/{id} and DELETE /books/{id} do not wrap int() conversion in try/except
findings.detail: Without try/except, a non-integer path ID triggers an unhandled ValueError instead of returning 400.
